documents.title: Overdue Pick Definition
documents.body: A pick order is overdue when the warehouse reference date is after its ship_by date and status is not 'shipped'. Overdue express picks require supervisor notification within 1 hour.

documents.title: Ship-By SLA
documents.body: Standard picks must ship by end of day on ship_by date. Express picks must ship by 2pm on ship_by date. Carrier cutoff for express is 3pm.

documents.title: Lot Traceability SOP
documents.body: To trace a SKU, pull lot events with wh_get_lot_trace, cross-reference open picks with wh_find_picks_by_sku, and check for qc_failed or damage_reported events.

documents.title: Cold Chain Compliance
documents.body: Cold chain SKUs must be picked within 30 minutes of cold zone exit. Workers need cold_chain certification. Verify temp_check_passed on lot before pick.

documents.title: Hazmat Pick Rules
documents.body: Hazmat SKUs require a hazmat-certified picker on the active shift. A lead must escort for first pick of the day. Check wms_get_shift_roster for certifications.

documents.title: Replenishment SOP
documents.body: Blocked replenishment tasks must be linked to a work order. Check equipment availability in the zone before assigning. Forklift down status blocks aisle A replenishment.

documents.title: Putaway Rules
documents.body: Inbound receipts must be put away within 24 hours. Cold items within 30 minutes. Planned putaway zone is on the inbound record. Staging default is R-01-01.

documents.title: Zone Routing
documents.body: Pick routes list zones in sequence. COLD zone required when any line item SKU has cold_chain=true. Minimize cold zone entries to one per pick.

documents.title: Damage and Hold Policy
documents.body: Locations with status damaged_hold or bin contents with status damaged cannot be picked. Quarantine affected lots and open an incident. Cycle count required before release.

documents.title: Equipment Assignment
documents.body: Each zone has assigned forklifts and reach trucks. Equipment with status 'down' blocks replenishment work orders in that zone until maintenance clears it.
